title: Nukes all around? A fraying U.S. nuclear umbrella is pushing allies to weigh defense options, raising risk of a proliferation cascade
summary_full: As countries take more responsibility for their own defense and nuclear states step back from arms-control commitments, the question of proliferation arises.
summary_public: As countries take more responsibility for their own defense and nuclear states step back from arms-control commitments, the question of proliferation arises.
